author: KEXP
description: Bay Area legend Lyrics Born brings funk-infused classic hip-hop to 25th Street Recording in our latest Live on KEXP at Noisepop session. With host Larry Mizell, Jr., he shares a performance of "Callin' Out" and more.
title: Lyrics Born performs "Callin' Out" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
